Method of Attack: Ransomware that pretends to represent a sick children's charity to coerce victims into paying ransom as if it was a charitable donation
Uses stories and information taken from legitimate crowdfunding pages for sick children to deceive victims
Drops ransom note with email addresses for payment instructions and unique victim ID
Sends email from 'Worldwide Children Charity Community' with sick child's profile and a One Time Secret link for payment instructions
Continues the charity deception throughout the payment process, including payment completion message with link to decryptor
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note containing multiple email addresses and unique victim ID
One Time Secret site messages linked in emails
Link to decryptor sent after payment
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to ransom note and email communication
